name: Your, Endless Mind
source: Do you really want to know? You must understand - there is no way back. Here, every action of yours has consequences. Do you think that you know everything about yourself? I will prove to you that this is not the case. Are you ready? It is already waiting. Your, Endless Mind.
translation: 你真的想知道吗？你必须明白——没有回头路。在这里，你的每一个行动都会产生后果。你认为你了解自己的一切吗？我会向你证明事实并非如此。你准备好了吗？它已经在等待了。你的，无尽的心灵。
